1936, November
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 150 Cont.
Nov. 11th
Anthony Jungworth - 76 - eyes .....
11 Mrs. Hughes - 57 - Glucomic Eyes
12 Anna Kellenberger - 10 - recovering from accident - fatal for her sister 15. She herself was unconscious for two week was enrolled after that time in S. Mass A. - began at once to improve ... a "trailer" broke loose and killed the sister instantly. Thank to God requested.
13 Anna Zielenski - 74 has started drinking - very much dissatisfied.
Page 151
Nov. 15 Franci Schneider - 15 - "no faith: don't want to go to church or Sac- raments; seems never to have cared to go .... Enrolled Today in -
Baby John Moluszkowski - 3 mo. "Heart tuomers - beautiful bright; but Dr's give no hope. Enrolled To-day $5.00 Fath.
Henery C. Tack - 38 - Davenport Hospital, nerveous now three years ... wife non Catholic
16 Miss Needham - 54 - of Smiths Creek, liver cancer
17 Mrs. Rose Nowicki - 40 - "lost" her little Germaine who received First Holy Comm'n Wednesday June 3rd and died following Sund'y June 7th. Doctors could not find the trouble - tested for spinal maningitis re- petedly calculated after death that it was probably a mastoid burst. Mother nearly lost her mind - even turned on gas to "put end to it all" After a moment and before too late changed her mind .... Prayers were asked at time and a number of times since. Now parents realize that she is obtaining extraordinary blessings for them and conversions of bitter-irreligious relatives. Deo Grat.
Richard
Marg. Richardson - 40 - Methodist -bluring in I eye - sight poor ....
Page 152
Anna Schock - 39 - nerveous break. . .. Hatty Jacobs Abba Cole - 47 - of Toledo - threatened with cancer.
